definitions.explanation: A person who provides expert advice to an organization, company, or government body. Composed of 顧 (look back, take care of) + 問 (ask, question). In Japanese schools, also refers to the teacher who supervises a club or team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顧問|こもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He serves as an advisor to the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顧問|こもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The teacher who advises our club is very strict.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{顧問|こもん}⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult the legal advisor regarding legal matters.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese schools, every club (⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧) must have a {顧問|こもん} — a teacher who supervises and sometimes coaches the club. This is a significant responsibility and a distinctive feature of the Japanese school system. In business, {顧問|こもん} often refers to a retired executive who remains in an advisory role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {顧問|こもん}⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧ (legal advisor, attorney on retainer)
- {顧問|こもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (to serve as an advisor)
- ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顧問|こもん} (club advisor — at school)
- {顧問|こもん}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (advisory/consulting contract)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧{顧問|こもん} (technical advisor)
